hnsw.note: VLite HnswConfig defaults, applied explicitly to every engine exposing them

metric: squared L2 / Euclidean; recall is ID-based and tie-aware against a float64 oracle
latency: sequential, one client thread, one query in flight; QPS = queries / sum(latency)

durability.vlite: Each batch is one atomic commit fsynced before acknowledgment (default).
durability.zvec: Defaults; the harness calls flush() before close. Per-insert fsync was not verified.
durability.chroma: Defaults: SQLite-backed write-ahead log; HNSW segment files are persisted asynchronously in batches (sync_threshold). Not fsync per add().
durability.lancedb: Defaults: each add() writes data files and commits a new table version (manifest). Per-commit fsync was not verified.
durability.faiss: In-memory library baseline: no persistence, no durability, no reopen.
